text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like this? Is this the way,
this is how you pace a long-distance race?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Keep your breathing steady during the middle,
and then finish it off with a BOOM!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've grasped it now.
An' I won't forget it—never.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross gained solid confidence
from the Tenno Sho (Spring) prep race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, but I tell ya, Trainer.
It feels mighty fine havin' a crystal-clear goal right in front of ya."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Twinkle Series goes on forever, right?
Still, once in a while...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be able to tell my family, "I did this!"
Somethin' concrete and huge, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)... The race Dad
always said he wanted me to run in...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We can really do this, right?!
With our heads held high!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's head to the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Yeah, let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've finally made it this far!
My back's shiverin' all over...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's go take a look at that shield Dad admired so much, Trainer. We'll train our tails off until that day comes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And another great wave was also swelling up
separately from that.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap takes back-to-back graded race victories!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A tough situation from the back! Her legs
almost stopped for a moment, but she powers through to a thrilling victory!
2,000m on turf is no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's keep this momentum going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Excitement runs high as the Senior Class focuses on the Tenno Sho (Spring), while the Classic Class sets their sights on the Triple Crown and Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aside from all that, however, a rising star from the regional circuits
named Oguri Cap was beginning to create a third wave...
